# Содержимое файла vpnConf.ts {#sec-api-vpnConf .appendix}

``` python
import { exec } from 'child_process';
import fs from 'fs/promises'
import path from 'path'
import { promisify } from 'util';

const execPromise = promisify(exec);

const EASY_RSA_DIR = 'easy-rsa';
const CLIENT_COMMON_FILE = 'client-common.txt';
const PKI_INLINE_PRIVATE_DIR = path.join(EASY_RSA_DIR, 'pki', 'inline', 'private');
const CONFIGS_DIR = 'vpn';

export async function generateClientCertificate(clientName: string) {
  const command = `cd ${EASY_RSA_DIR} && ./easyrsa --batch --days=3650 build-client-full "${clientName}" nopass`;
  try {
    const { stdout } = await execPromise(command);
    return stdout;

  } catch (error) {
    
    throw error;
  }
}

export async function buildOvpFile(clientName: string) {
  const commonContent = await fs.readFile(CLIENT_COMMON_FILE, 'utf8');
  const filteredCommon = commonContent.split('\n')
    .filter(line => !line.trim().startsWith('#'))
    .join('\n');

  const inlinePath = path.join(PKI_INLINE_PRIVATE_DIR, `${clientName}.inline`);
  let inlineContent = '';
  try {
    inlineContent = await fs.readFile(inlinePath, 'utf8');
  } catch (err) {
    throw new Error(`Cannot read inline file for ${clientName}: ${(err as Error).message}`);
  }
  const filteredInline = inlineContent.split('\n')
    .filter(line => !line.trim().startsWith('#'))
    .join('\n');
  
  const resultFile = `${filteredCommon}\n${filteredInline}`
  const filePath = path.join(CONFIGS_DIR, `${clientName}.ovpn`);
  await fs.writeFile(filePath, resultFile, 'utf8');

  return resultFile;
}
```
